name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2107: ADVANCED was rendering in full, below the fold. At the window size the app actually creates - 1120 by 660 - the rail is 490px tall holding 1191px of content, so the Grok Eyes card landed at y510 and the switches at y752 against a viewport ending at 660. v2076 anticipated this and scrolled with block nearest, which moves the least it can, and for a card one pixel inside the viewport the least is one pixel. Now it comes to the top: card fully visible at y180, switches fully visible at y422. And the console fetches its own update without being asked - the pull is safe and reversible - while the RELAUNCH stays his click, because the app already refuses to restart while he is filming.
